Container.Name: nginx-ui-swag
Container.Overview: Official Nginx UI controller template for an existing LinuxServer SWAG container. The bundled Nginx instance is disabled. This template requires the Docker socket and a shared SWAG /config mount; review the security warning in the README before installing.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: nginx reverse proxy linuxserver swag certificate
Container.Requires: An existing LinuxServer SWAG container. The Docker socket grants root-equivalent host control. The SWAG appdata directory must be mounted at /config in both containers.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Direct Nginx UI backend port. Do not expose it to the internet.

Config.Name: Nginx UI appdata
Config.Description: Nginx UI database, settings, and startup secret.

Config.Name: SWAG appdata
Config.Description: Use the same host directory SWAG mounts at /config. The container target must remain /config.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Required to test, reload, and restart Nginx in SWAG. Grants root-equivalent host control.

Config.Name: Disable bundled Nginx
Config.Description: Run Nginx UI only and leave the bundled Nginx service idle.

Config.Name: SWAG container name
Config.Description: Exact Docker container name of the existing SWAG instance.

Config.Name: Nginx configuration directory
Config.Description: SWAG Nginx configuration directory in the shared mount.

Config.Name: Nginx configuration file
Config.Description: SWAG main Nginx configuration file in the shared mount.

Config.Name: Nginx access log
Config.Description: SWAG access log in the shared mount.

Config.Name: Nginx error log
Config.Description: SWAG error log in the shared mount.

Config.Name: Nginx log allowlist
Config.Description: Directory Nginx UI may read for log analysis.
